_readme: Affiliate link map. mode=param: append query params to the merchant URL (template uses {url} nowhere, params joined with & or ?). mode=wrap: replace href with template, {url} = URL-encoded original. mode=skimlinks: handled by the sitewide JS snippet, no per-link rewrite. status=active entries with a non-null id are the only ones apply-affiliates.py touches. Lenny signs up for each program himself; drop the id/template in here and re-run apply-affiliates.py --apply.

_skimlinks.note: Set provider to 'skimlinks' or 'sovrn' + publisher_id once the account exists; apply-affiliates.py --apply then installs the snippet sitewide. Covers big-box merchants (PGA Tour Superstore, Dick's, adidas, TaylorMade, etc.) automatically.
